pages.text: $(italic)Sturdy, slow and made for underground work. Dwarves excel in Tiers 1 and 2, when mining and forging dominate.$()$(br2)$(bold)Deep Delver$(): +15% mining speed.$(br2)$(bold)Forge-Hardened$(): fire damage is halved.$(br2)$(bold)Sturdy Build$(): +2 armor toughness.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Miner's Appetite$(): every block you break gives you a moment of Saturation, which offsets the hunger mining costs.$(br2)$(bold)Short Legs$(): $(warn)-5% movement speed.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Paladin or Artificer, then go strip a cave. Your +15% pick pays from minute one.$()
